2609.05097.title: NEAT-POCKET: Pocket-Conditioned Autoregressive 3D Molecular Generation with a Neighborhood-Guided Set Transformer
2609.05097.paper_summary: AI-driven de novo molecular design offers a promising route to accelerate early-stage drug discovery by generating novel ligands directly within target protein binding pockets. We present NEAT-POCKET, a pocket-conditioned extension of the autoregressive NEAT model for 3D molecular generation. NEAT-POCKET generates molecules atom by atom in protein pocket environments while preserving atom permutation invariance and explicitly modeling hydrogen atoms. Benchmarks on the CrossDocked and SPINDR datasets show that NEAT-POCKET achieves competitive structure-based generation performance while sampling substantially faster than existing baselines. Beyond full-molecule generation, NEAT-POCKET naturally enables pocket-conditioned fragment completion, a task directly relevant to lead optimization and scaffold elaboration. These results position NEAT-POCKET as a fast, flexible, and practical framework for structure-based drug design.
2609.05097.paper_summary_zh: AI 驅動的全新分子設計提供了一條有希望的途徑，以加速早期藥物發現，通過直接在目標蛋白質結合口袋中生成新型配體。我們提出了 NEAT-POCKET，這是一個基於口袋條件的自回歸 NEAT 模型的擴展，用於 3D 分子生成。NEAT-POCKET 在蛋白質口袋環境中逐原子生成分子，同時保持原子置換不變性並明確建模氫原子。在 CrossDocked 和 SPINDR 數據集上的基準測試顯示，NEAT-POCKET 在結構基礎的生成性能上達到了競爭力，同時在取樣速度上顯著快於現有基準。除了全分子生成外，NEAT-POCKET 自然支持基於口袋的片段補全，這一任務與主導優化和骨架擴展直接相關。這些結果使 NEAT-POCKET 成為一個快速、靈活且實用的結構基礎藥物設計框架。
